text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: P-7129 — inference-queue backlog high (queue_depth=10,800, p90_latency=2.4s). Auto-page to #eng-oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered P-7129, severity=high. Assigned to primary on-call: <@sara-ops>.

sara-ops: ack. I'm on it, pulling metrics. Can someone confirm customer-visible error rate?

james: I'm seeing increased 5xxs on hosted-api, about 1.2% in last 5m. Affected endpoint: /v1/generate

maria: confirmed. A few large batched workloads started hitting Dedicated pools out of region; routing fallback kicked in but got queued.

sara-ops: ok. Quick triage: is autoscaler not scaling or are nodes saturated?

leo: metrics

leo: ridge-metrics snapshot:
```
queue_depth: 10800
autoscaler.desired_replicas: 8
autoscaler.current_replicas: 6
gpu_util: 98%
pending_pod_creations: 40
k8s_event: ImagePullBackOff on 2 pods
```

sara-ops: ImagePullBackOff? that would block pod creation and explain pending_pod_creations. Any registry or deploy happening?

james: Yep, there was a canary push to the runtime image 10m ago, registry issue caused throttled pulls. Trying to cancel rollout.

maria: On it — rolling back the canary tag to previous image and forcing imagePullPolicy=IfNotPresent for now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: "Investigating registry pulls causing delayed pod start; manual mitigation in progress."

sara-ops: Plan: 1) cancel rollout / rollback image 2) bump replicas manually to absorb backlog 3) enable emergency-burst pool routing 4) customer impact comms if errors persist. Agreed?

james: +1. I'll do manual scale for the serving deployment to 12 replicas to buy time.

leo: I can enable burst pool routing via routing-manager to send new requests to fallback small-model cluster (latency higher but keeps throughputs).

maria: rollback pushed, started clearing ImagePullBackOffs by restarting kubelets on 2 nodes.

sara-ops: Execute manual scale now: runbook command
```
kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=12 -n prod
```

james: Ran scale command, API shows desired=12, kube events show pods creating but pending due to ImagePullBackOff previously. Maria's rollback should help.

maria: rollback completed at +90s, kube now pulling previous image successfully.

leo: routing-manager: enabling emergency-burst for tenant-tier=hosted; command executed.

incident-bot: System: routing fallback enabled for hosted-tier (rule id rf-0821).

sara-ops: Monitoring queue_depth and 5xx after actions. Can folks watch logs for new 5xxs and errors due to model fallback?

james: 5xx trend flattening, new requests getting 503 less, but backlog still drains slowly. queue_depth=8300.

maria: Pod starts progressing; 6 new pods transitioned to Running in last 60s.

leo: After reroute, latency for fallback is ~350ms extra; customers with strict SLO may notice degraded quality.

sara-ops: Noted. We should prepare internal comms: what customers impacted and suggested mitigation (retry/backoff)?

james: Top affected customers by traffic: acme-inc, finlytics, chatloop (IDs: c-441, c-817, c-1221). Sending DM to account leads.

maria: I can put together a short status note for support: state, mitigation, ETA. ETA to full recovery ~10-15m if pods keep coming up.

sara-ops: Good. PagerDuty: can you add timeline and mitigations to the incident and set status to investigating -> mitigated? (we'll keep incident open until backlog <500)

pagerduty: Note added. Incident severity remains high. On-call handoff scheduled in 50m.

leo: queue_depth=4200 and dropping. p90_latency back to ~1.1s. Very few new 5xxs.

sara-ops: Nice. I'll stay until we hit <500 and then hand off to next on-call for follow-up postmortem.

incident-bot: PD P-7129 acknowledged by <@sara-ops> at 1976543210.

sara-ops: handoff to <@oncall-manager> in 48m. Interim actions: keep scaling policy paused for this cluster until postmortem, and block new canaries to runtime image.

james: adding label `no-canary` to runtime image group across clusters.

maria: support note posted: "Customers may see degraded latency; mitigations applied. Next update in 15m." :loud_sound: 

leo: queue_depth=280 and trending to zero. Pods stable.

sara-ops: backlog drained below 500. Marking incident as resolved for paging. We'll convert to follow-up ticket for root cause and release gating.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P-7129 status updated to acknowledged -> resolved (paging cleared) at 1976543450. Follow-up: create RFC for image-push gating and autoscaler health checks.

sara-ops: thanks team. great fast reactions. I'll file the postmortem and schedule a blameless RCA.

james: thx all.

maria: :thumbsup: 

oncall-manager: I'll take the follow-up and coordinate with registry team — leaving note here. Good job.
